tools.name: create_sample_deck
tools.description: Make a hosted, shareable presentation from a short prompt with no PitchBoost account: a lesson or lecture, a class or thesis presentation, a report or update, a talk, or a sales or investor pitch, in any language. The deck carries a small PitchBoost badge and the response includes a single-use claim

tools.name: create_deck
tools.description: Make a presentation in the user's PitchBoost account from a prompt: a lesson or lecture, a class or thesis presentation, a report or update, a talk or workshop, or a sales or investor pitch, in any language. Returns a shareable link. Generation takes up to ~60 seconds.

tools.name: rebuild_deck
tools.description: Improve, redesign, polish or rebrand an existing presentation of any kind (coursework, a lecture, a report, a pitch) in any language. tools.name: get_rebuild_status
tools.description: Check whether a rebuild started with rebuild_deck has finished. Returns the shareable link and editor link when the deck is ready, or how long it has been running.

tools.name: publish_deck
tools.description: Turn a deck's shareable link on. Rebuilt and generated decks go live at their share_url as soon as they are finished; use this when the user made one private and wants the link back. Not destructive and safe to repeat.

tools.name: list_decks
tools.description: List the most recent published decks for your team, each with its shareable link.

tools.name: get_deck
tools.description: Get a single deck by its numeric id, including its shareable link and metadata.
